english.note: 錄音 means record sound. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Forget it. If we record it, we might reveal some secrets later. Really not worth it. It’s so little—they might laugh at us later.
exampleSentences.traditional: 費事喇。錄咗音陣間又要講出啲秘密出來，無謂喇真係。咁鬼少。陣間俾人笑嗎會。
